generate_context_embeddings: generate multi-vector context embeddings from a checkpoint and save expert representations to pickle files
generate_query_embeddings: generate multi-vector query embeddings and save query representations with weights and topic IDs to pickle files
rerank_query_context_pairs: rerank query-context pairs using expert similarity scoring with max or sum pooling strategies
encode_contexts: encode context token IDs into multi-vector representations using the context encoder with expert IDs and weights
compute_expert_similarity: compute expert-level similarity scores between query and context representations using batch matrix multiplication
